Title: Gemini Ai studio broken - Gemini API - Google AI Developers Forum
# Gemini Ai studio broken. I’ve been a regular user of Gemini AI Studio (aistudio.google.com) and I’m running into a frustrating issue that many others are also reporting. This morning there were clear UI bugs (buttons unresponsive, sidebar disappearing, heavy lag). Now, even on a paid Pay-as-you-go plan with almost zero usage (literally just opening a new chat), I immediately get “Quota Exceeded” or “Resource has been exhausted” errors. The quota dashboard still shows plenty of remaining tokens, so it looks like the system is incorrectly routing paid accounts to free-tier limits. This started after the recent updates and the big free-tier quota cut in December 2025. It’s making the studio almost unusable for paid users. Fix the backend routing bug between paid and free tiers. Make the quota/rate limits a bit more lenient for paying customers. Improve overall stability so these sudden bugs don’t keep happening. Log in with active paid billing. Create a brand new chat/project. Type anything simple → Instant quota error. Happy to provide screenshots, API key details (privately), or anything else that helps. It’s cause there’s a UI bug in the interface from a prompt injection I reported samething earlier along as a tag to gain access to files. # Ai studio QuickStart doesn’t seem to match the interface - frustrating! Screenshot attached at bottom - would love to attach another but it says new users can only attach one image. I’m trying to do a Google class that requires me to use ai studio for a simple agent creation exercise, but it’s driving me nuts. The google AI Studio QuickStart says:. Chat will be pre-selected on the left side options menu. (It’s not even there much less selected and I can’t find it anywhere.). Click the assignment icon at the top of the Chat Prompt window to expand the system instructions input field. (There is no such icon, but if you click the gear top right it will open the system instructions.). After you’ve added the system instructions, start testing your application by chatting with the model. In the text input boxed labeled “type something” type in a question or observation that a user might make. For example: “What’s the weather like?” (There is no input box labeled “type something”.). Next click the “run button”. (There is no such button.). It’s probably something easy, but after hours of wasted time and useless research all over the net and Gemini and YouTube, I came up with nothing. ### Related topics. | AI driven tutorial how to use AI Studio to create a 60 video on AI Studio complete failure  Google AI Studio ai-studio | 2 | 66 | December 23, 2025 |. | Thoughts on the New UI?
